messages.subject: Infineon Thailand | New manufacturing hub, sustainability and external stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Infineon Thailand Talent and Leadership Team,

Infineon's new backend manufacturing hub in Thailand, inaugurated on October 1, 2026, marks a major expansion of the country's semiconductor ecosystem and a significant long-term investment in advanced manufacturing and talent.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring experience supporting multinational investment in a regulated environment, managing public institutions, communities and cross-functional operating teams. My recent work also includes renewable-energy transition and carbon-data governance. This background would support Infineon's Thailand growth where investment, sustainability, workforce development and institutional relationships converge.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached an Infineon Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
